title: Tourist Season, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Lockbox summer. A tourist in Chloe's parents' old house asks Wood for directions to the beach in the strip. He gives them. He doesn't say whose house.

panels.composition: The sidewalk outside the house four doors down. A TOURIST family on its porch. The mother waving WOOD over, phone out, the strip on it.

balloons.text: Excuse me — the beach in this. With the log. Is it walkable?

image.prompt: a tourist family on the porch of an old wooden house with a key lockbox on the door, the mother holding out a phone showing a comic to a man on the sidewalk with a three-legged dog, clean ink

panels.composition: Wood looking at the phone. Then at the porch. The step where he sat in October 2000.

image.prompt: close-up of a man looking at a porch step with a memory on his face, no words

balloons.text: End of the road. Left at the log. Twenty minutes.
Do you know the artist? Is he local?

image.prompt: a man pointing down a street for a tourist family, answering briefly

panels.composition: Wood walking on with the pup. The family going in. The lockbox swinging on the knob of the door he never knocked on.

image.prompt: a man and a three-legged dog walking away from an old house as a family goes inside, the key lockbox swinging on the doorknob, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Directions to his own Sunday, from her porch. 'He's around.'
